about: First test: 6 things chat would ask for + 4 mood props the emotion system would bring in. Some are deliberately hard shapes (thin, hollow, fluffy) to learn what Tripo handles.

props.tests: the classic chat request; simple solid shape, should be easy
props.subject: a pirate captain's tricorn hat, black felt with gold trim and a small white skull emblem on the front

props.tests: hard edges, gems and shiny gold
props.subject: a royal gold crown with red and blue gems

props.tests: thin headband with ears: will Tripo keep the band or melt it into a blob?
props.subject: a headband with fluffy pink-and-white cat ears

props.tests: very thin frames and see-through lenses: the hardest shape in this batch
props.subject: a pair of chunky black star-shaped party sunglasses

props.tests: long thin held item; checks hand placement
props.subject: a cartoon fantasy sword with a blue gem in the hilt

props.tests: a little companion that rides on the shoulder
props.subject: a classic yellow rubber duck with an orange beak

props.tests: two separate pieces on one headband
props.subject: a pair of curved red devil horns on a thin black headband

props.tests: soft fluffy shape with raindrops hanging under it
props.subject: a small grey cartoon storm cloud with a few blue raindrops hanging beneath it

props.tests: simple shape; checks whether it can glow nicely in Unity
props.subject: a puffy glossy pink cartoon heart

props.tests: a thin ring with a hole in the middle
props.subject: a golden angel halo ring
